## Checklist

- [ ] The PR addresses one concern and does not include unrelated workspace changes.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or I explained why no test is applicable.
- [ ] Relevant narrow checks pass before broader CI-shaped checks.
- [ ] Public behavior and claim surfaces are documented conservatively.
- [ ] User-visible changes have an `Unreleased` changelog entry in an allowed category.
- [ ] Generated evidence was regenerated through its producer, not edited by hand.
- [ ] No raw participant data, credentials, private artifacts, or local-only `thoughts/`, `.agents/`, or `.claude/` files are included.
